notes.moderation_system: AI moderation uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for LLM-based content analysis. If key is missing, moderate_text returns None gracefully. Regex-based checks (scam_links, external_contacts) work without LLM.
notes.wallet_reconcile: POST /wallet/reconcile is idempotent and safe to call repeatedly. Scans last 24h of pending coin_pack transactions and credits any that Stripe reports as paid.
notes.webhook_fallback: When STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is missing in live mode, webhook endpoint parses event JSON unsigned and re-checks session via Stripe API before applying.
notes.policy_defaults: DEFAULT_MOD_POLICY has 9 enabled ban_* filters by default. ban_minors is always active (locked in UI).
